observations.shapeVolume: Original is a readable small coin with a stepped twelve-sided slab, shallow inset face and simple raised bar. Its silhouette is rigid and material planes merge. Target gives the rim more rounded thickness, deliberate front-face recess and bevel separation; these are valuable native form improvements, without requiring the old 9 mesh parts or 12-sided discs.
observations.color: Keep the unmistakable warm yellow/gold family and orange-gold symbol. Original top and rim become broad nearly saturated lemon-yellow regions. Target uses golden-orange side depth, yellow midtones and pale warm edge accents that better separate thickness from face.
observations.lightAndEdges: Broad soft lighting and rounded highlight rolloff should reveal the rim, inset and relief. The target has concentrated upper-left/left highlights and alpha debris; these are not requirements and must not reintroduce a preferred horizontal light or halo.
observations.materialDetail: Target coherent rim/face/bar construction and crisp sparkle silhouettes are useful. The single vertical currency bar is identity; extra text, numbers, reward props and arbitrary microtexture would weaken it. Spark count and old plus-beam construction are not technical locks.
observations.intendedSize: At 128px/cell, the original central coin is about 56 logical pixels wide in its broad phases; at representative phone 64px/cell it is about 28 pixels. Form separation must survive that size and the runtime alpha fade. Small first/last frames are intentional phase collapse, not missing-art dead spots.
observations.temporal: All 12 original frames are unique. Sequence grows from a near-vanished start, rises by .42 world units, turns .7 radians and collapses at end; it is not a 360-degree spin and does not loop. Four facings are byte-identical owing to native counterrotation.
observations.context: Catalog describes above-customer feedback, but actual same-root customer/stool context places the source coin over the customer torso during the visible phase. Preserve the measured emitter and root; this preparation does not authorize relocating feedback above the head.
observations.referenceLimits: ImageGen output has a different canvas (926x1699) and a substantially larger normalized coin than source; its alpha contains stray low-opacity pixels. It is visual design inspiration, not a camera/root/scale/temporal proof.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: A convincing rounded coin rim with readable thickness, recessed/stepped face and clean bar relief throughout the native yaw and pop.
Warm gold midtones with clear orange depth and restrained pale highlights; face, rim and currency mark stay distinguishable at phone scale.
Soft continuous edge highlights, purposeful sparkle shapes and no white glare sheet, black seam, alpha halo, detached relief or moving material defect.
Smooth 12-frame rise/grow/turn/shrink, coherent four-facing result and readable short reward feedback in actual customer context, with intentional near-vanished endpoints.
